title: Sectionwise pro-etale inverse image of modules
statement: Let $g:X\xrightarrow\sim Y$ be a scheme isomorphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Define sectionwise sheaf inverse image by precomposition with the site functor postcomposing structure maps with $g$. For ring sheaves $R_Y,R_X$ and a specified ring isomorphism $c:g^{-1}R_Y\xrightarrow\sim R_X$, define module inverse image [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] by the sheaf-of-modules pushforward along this site functor and $c^{-1}$. Its underlying sections and arrows are unchanged and its scalar action is transported by $c^{-1}$. For constant coefficient sheaves use the uniquely constant-section-normalized coefficient map. Coefficient universes may be any universe containing the site object universe; site object and morphism universes remain distinct. These are the published sectionwise constructions, not an assertion of their equivalence or exactness.
